title: EAIE president urges sector to face uncertainty and seize Erasmus reset
summary_en: Stakeholders gathering in Glasgow were urged to embrace “revolution”, confront rising uncertainty, and seize a “genuine reason for hope” as the UK and Switzerland prepare to rejoin Erasmus+.
author: Kim Martin
title_cn: EAIE president urges sector to face uncertainty and seize Erasmus reset

title: Catriona Olsen, King’s InterHigh
summary_en: This week, The PIE sat down with Catriona Olsen, the executive head of the DfE-accredited online school King’s InterHigh. We spoke about the school's new mentorship program and why the future of education is online.
author: The PIE News team

title: Studyportals and Made Impact partner to showcase personal international education stories
summary_en: Studyportals and Made Impact have partnered to launch a global platform designed to collect and amplify stories demonstrating the impact of international education and student mobility.
author: Beth Kennedy
title_cn: Studyportals and Made Impact partner to showcase personal international education stories
